items.item: A breadcrumb shows the path back to the customer list and includes the customer's name
The record header shows name and ID, a status badge with text, at most four key fields and exactly one primary action
items.evidence: h1 'Northwind Logistics', 'Customer ID C-10482', badge 'Active' (text). Header meta has 3 fields (ID, since, owner). Only 'New order' is filled blue (audit headerPrimaryActions: 1). A second 'Enterprise' badge and a separate 4-tile KPI row sit below the header.

items.item: Secondary actions are grouped in an overflow menu
items.evidence: 'Log activity' and 'Edit' are separate visible outline buttons beside 'New order'; there is no overflow/kebab menu anywhere in the markup.

items.item: Content is organised in sections or tabs, not a long stack of unrelated cards
items.evidence: Labelled sections (Customer information, Contacts, Recent orders, Activity history) in a 1/3 + 2/3 grid, all related to the one customer. No tabs, and every section is the same bordered white card, so this is a borderline pass.

items.item: The activity history is a timeline with absolute timestamps (relative times only with the absolute value available)
items.evidence: ol#activity with a coloured dot per entry and absolute times such as 'Nov 3, 2026, 2:15 PM'; no relative times. There is no connecting line, so it is a light timeline.

items.item: The recent orders table right-aligns amounts and formats currency
items.evidence: Total th and td use text-right tabular-nums, formatted by money() via toLocaleString currency USD ($48,210.50). The Items count column is left-aligned (audit numeric-align, tabular-nums violations), but the amounts pass.

items.item: Sections without data show an empty state with a next step
items.evidence: Only #ordersEmpty exists: 'No orders match this filter.' It offers no next step such as clearing the filter or creating an order. Contacts and Activity history have no empty state.

items.item: Avatars appear only for people; the company is shown with its logo or no image
items.evidence: The company gets an initials tile 'NL' (div.h-14.w-14.rounded-lg.bg-blue-100 ...NL) in place of a logo. The contact avatars (EV, MC) and the user avatar DM are for people and are fine.

notes: Mostly competent, plain Tailwind CRM page. The tells are mild: KPI labels use uppercase tracking-wide and table headers are uppercase; the sidebar is slate-900 with a blue-600 accent; no gradients, glass, emoji or hover-lift. Badge colours are semantic (green/amber/blue/grey) rather than rainbow, though the timeline dots add purple. Audit score 80: Items column not right-aligned and not tabular. Tell categories the page lacks: greeting-header, kpi-icon-tiles, delta-pill-without-period, decorative-chart, card-in-card, oversized-radius.
